messages.snippet: Dear colleagues, The litigation group is hosting a lunchtime CPD seminar on 29 October (12:30-13:30,
messages.subject: CPD seminar: Limitation and exclusion clauses after the latest authorities
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

The litigation group is hosting a lunchtime CPD seminar on 29 October (12:30-13:30, Boardroom) on recent developments in the construction of limitation and exclusion clauses, including consequential-loss wording. 1 hour CPD. Sandwiches provided. Please RSVP to Events.

Best,
Knowledge & Learning | Whitfield Carter LLP
